### Wisdom and Revelation by the Spirit
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wisdom-and-revelation-spirit
Passage: Ephesians 1:17
Points:
- Believers need ongoing doctrinal understanding and ethical guidance to grow into mature faith.
- Paul is not asking for the Holy Spirit to be given again, but for deeper spiritual illumination.
- At regeneration the Spirit removes spiritual blindness, and He continues providing insight into Scripture.
- This wisdom and revelation is the standard work of the Spirit for all believers, not an elite gift.

### What It Means to Have the Eyes of Our Hearts Opened
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/what-it-means-to-have-the-eyes-of-our-hearts-opened-bible-study-minute-march-14-2019.html
Passage: Ephesians 1:16-18
Points:
- God originally created humans with spiritual sight, but the fall plunged humanity into spiritual blindness.
- Having the eyes of our hearts enlightened reveals the rich hope and inheritance found in Christ.
- Without the Spirit opening our inner eyes, people remain blind to the truths of the gospel.
- Daily prayer should include asking God to keep our spiritual sight clear and attentive toward Him.
